# Naver (12 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /blog/search | `query` | 1 | Search Naver Blog |
| /news/search | `query` | 1 | Search Naver News |
| /book/search | `query` | 1 | Search Naver Book |
| /encyc/search | `query` | 1 | Search Naver Encyclopedia |
| /cafearticle/search | `query` | 1 | Search Naver Cafe articles |
| /kin/search | `query` | 1 | Search Naver KnowledgeiN (지식iN) |
| /local/search | `query` | 1 | Search Naver Local (장소 검색) |
| /shop/search | `query` | 1 | Search Naver Shopping |
| /doc/search | `query` | 1 | Search Naver Academic Documents (전문자료) |
| /image/search | `query` | 1 | Search Naver Image |
| /webkr/search | `query` | 1 | Search Naver Web (웹문서) |
| /brief | `query` | **10** | One query across the Korean internet (6 Naver corpora) + optional digest. |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- *(none)* — no required parameters.

## Parameter Details

- `query`: Free-text search term (UTF-8). Required.
- `display` *(optional, integer)*: Number of items to return per page. Defaults to 10. Standard cap 100 (local corpus caps at 5).
- `start` *(optional, integer)*: 1-indexed offset for pagination. Defaults to 1. Standard cap 1000 (local corpus caps at 1).
- `sort` *(optional, string)*: Sort order. Accepted values: sim|date. Defaults to `sim` (relevance) when the corpus supports sort.
- `sort (/book/search)` *(optional, string)*: Sort order. Accepted values: sim|date|asc|dsc (asc/dsc = price asc/desc). Defaults to `sim` (relevance) when the corpus supports sort.
- `sort (/encyc/search)` *(optional, string)*: Sort order. Accepted values: (sort ignored). Defaults to `sim` (relevance) when the corpus supports sort.
- `sort (/kin/search)` *(optional, string)*: Sort order. Accepted values: sim|date|point. Defaults to `sim` (relevance) when the corpus supports sort.
- `sort (/local/search)` *(optional, string)*: Sort order. Accepted values: random|comment (display max 5, start max 1). Defaults to `sim` (relevance) when the corpus supports sort.
- `sort (/shop/search)` *(optional, string)*: Sort order. Accepted values: sim|date|asc|dsc (asc/dsc = price asc/desc). Defaults to `sim` (relevance) when the corpus supports sort.
- `sort (/doc/search)` *(optional, string)*: Sort order. Accepted values: (sort ignored). Defaults to `sim` (relevance) when the corpus supports sort.
- `sort (/webkr/search)` *(optional, string)*: Sort order. Accepted values: (sort ignored). Defaults to `sim` (relevance) when the corpus supports sort.
- `query (/brief)`: Search query (Korean or any language).
- `corpora` *(optional, string)*: CSV subset of news,blog,cafearticle,kin,shop,webkr (default all six).
- `display (/brief)` *(optional, integer)*: Items per corpus (1–100, default 20).
- `start (/brief)` *(optional, integer)*: 1-indexed offset per corpus (1–1000, default 1). Prefer `cursor` for paging.
- `sort (/brief)` *(optional, string)*: sim (relevance, default) or date; shop also asc/dsc (price); kin also point.
- `include` *(optional, string)*: Set to `digest` for an LLM English digest with translated quotes.
- `cursor` *(optional, string)*: Opaque pagination token from a prior response's next_cursor.

## Example

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/naver/blog/search?query=소셜크롤" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
